summary: Phase 6 / S6 backup policies, Core scheduler, retention and Controller/UI relay.

guide.reason: Operators can create, pause and run backup policies from Backups → Policies.

api.reason: Adds backup policy CRUD/pause/run-now on Controller and Core-local APIs, ManagedState backup_policies inventory, additive BackupRun schedule fields and compact backup_authority replica refs.

roadmap.reason: S6 implementation only; Phase 6 gate remains open until S7/S8 and lab campaigns close.

state.record: Master pool-backup-policies.json (stable job/schedule IDs, enabled/paused, rules, time zones, next/last dispatch, VM selection, repository, capture mode, retention, overrides, revision). Run history under pool-backup-runs/ with occurrence IDs and missed/overlap outcomes. Compact backup_authority refs on the signed pool authority replica. Fresh Controller adopts policies and runs from authenticated master inventory when backup_policies_reported and backup_runs_reported are true.
state.reason: Schedules and policies must work without Controller and survive Controller replacement.

verification.method: go test -count=1 ./internal/protocol/ ./internal/agent/ ./internal/controller/ ./internal/localcore/; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree. Unit coverage: DST gap/repeat, duplicate occurrence refusal, Controller-absent tick, retention vs protect.
